_comment: LBNL FDD boiler-plant point -> CAMBER Role mapping, at the plant (loop) level: two boilers (_1/_2) and two hot-water pumps feed one loop; boiler 1 and pump 1 are the lead units. Derived from the dataset's own Brick model (LBNL_FDD_Data_Sets_Boiler_Plant_ttl) and checked against the data. BOI_STA_1 / BOI_STA_2 are NOT mapped: the Brick model types them On_Off_Status, and in this simulation they are the boiler ENABLE (on all season), not burner firing -- mapping one to boiler_status would read every enabled-but-idle hour as firing (short-cycle, summer-lockout and plant-delta-T rules would all misfire). The gas points (BOI_GAS_CSUM_*) are each boiler's instantaneous gas input in kW (inventory Table 2; not a cumulative counter despite the name -- corrected in 0.86.0) and, with the heating-demand point (SEC_POW), have no CAMBER role yet. HWL_DP and HWL_DPSPT are the loop differential pressure and its setpoint, both in inH2O (the inventory's Table 2 describes HWL_DPSPT as a temperature setpoint; it is the 17.4 psi DP setpoint). Units are IP as exported (temperatures in F). Dataset: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets (CC-BY).
